device.backendOfflineHint: Is the backend running? Start it with: ./scripts/start-backend.sh
device.brightnessVirtual: An overlay has no backlight — its tiles look exactly as they were designed.

pages.title: Pages
pages.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}” and all its sub pages?
pages.cannotDeleteRoot: The home page cannot be deleted.
pages.dragHint: Drag to sort, drop onto a page to nest it

library.title: Actions
library.dragHint: Drag an action onto a key or dial

grid.pasteWrongInput: The copied action cannot be placed on {{input}}.

inspector.title: Properties
inspector.nothingSelectedHint: Pick a key or dial on the left.
inspector.empty: This position is not assigned yet.
inspector.longPressHint: Second action when the key is held longer than {{ms}} ms.
inspector.label: Label
inspector.pageHint: Properties of page “{{name}}”. Select a key to edit its action.
inspector.keyLogicHint: Press, double press (within {{double}} ms) or hold (from {{long}} ms). Without a second branch the key still fires immediately.
inspector.dialLogicHint: Without an assigned direction the base action adjusts continuously. Assigning a direction triggers instead — like a short press.
inspector.turnEveryHint: A brisk turn is easily a dozen detents. 1 triggers on every one.

icons.title: Choose icon
icons.dropOrClick: Drop a file here or click

background.title: Background
background.transparentHint: Lets the page's wallpaper show through. Without a page image the segment stays black, so nothing changes.
background.imageHint: PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF or SVG. Animated GIFs play on the key.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.reorderHint: Drag plugins by the handle to reorder them — the order also applies to the action list in the editor.
plugins.discardChanges: There are unsaved changes. Close anyway?
plugins.dropArchive: Drop a plugin archive (.zip) here or click
plugins.uninstallConfirm: Remove “{{name}}”? Assignments using this plugin will be deleted.
plugins.trustWarning: A plugin is program code running with your permissions. Only install plugins from sources you trust.
plugins.requestTitle: A plugin wants to be installed
plugins.screensaversHint: Draw the screensaver across the whole deck. Pick one under Settings → Screensaver.
plugins.wallpapersHint: Draw the background behind the dial segments. Pick one under Settings → Touch strip wallpaper.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autostartHint: Starts the backend together with the graphical session. Takes effect at the next login — the running service is left alone.
settings.swipeHint: Swipe left to go forward, right to go back. Tapping still goes to the assigned action.
settings.swipeWraps: Wrap around to the first page
settings.exportHint: Saves the complete configuration as a JSON file.
settings.doublePressHint: Only keys with a double press assigned wait this long.
settings.animationsHint: Costs USB bandwidth — every frame travels to the device.
settings.perDeckHint: These settings apply to the deck selected above.

screensaver.title: Screensaver
screensaver.hint: After a period of inactivity, lays one image across all keys and the touch strip. Any input ends it immediately.
screensaver.testing: The screensaver is running — press a key to end it.
screensaver.previewHint: This is how the image reaches the device. The black bands are the bezels between the keys — whatever falls there will not be visible.
screensaver.afterHint: Counted from the last input on the deck. Independent of dimming.

wallpaper.title: Touch strip wallpaper
wallpaper.hint: Sits behind the four dial segments of this page. Every page can have its own image.
wallpaper.previewHint: The full strip. The thin lines mark where the four dial segments meet.
wallpaper.sizeHint: The strip is 800 × 100 pixels, one segment 200 × 100. An image with this aspect ratio is not cropped.
wallpaper.opacityHint: Below 100% the image recedes so icons and labels stay readable.
wallpaper.slotHint: The image only shows where a segment has no background of its own. Giving a dial a colour deliberately covers it.

multi.title: Steps
multi.empty: No steps yet — drag an action from the library here
multi.dropHint: Dropping onto a step inserts before it.
multi.dropZone: Drag an action here (appends at the end)

stack.title: Dial stack
stack.hint: Several assignments on one dial. On the device, holding it switches to the next.

creator.title: Design key image
creator.previewHint: This is how the image reaches the key (288 × 288).
creator.imageError: The image could not be loaded.

decks.title: Decks
decks.hint: Each device has its own pages, brightness and screensaver. They are matched by serial number.
decks.name: Name
decks.forgetConfirm: Remove “{{name}}” and its assignment? The layout stays as a profile.
decks.hotkeyHint: Brings this overlay up and sends it away again — from anywhere, without opening the interface. The shortcut is registered with Plasma and also shows up in System Settings under “DECK//SWITCH”. Empty field = no shortcut.
decks.virtualHint: Grid and tile size of this overlay. Changes take effect immediately.
decks.addVirtualHint: A virtual deck sits as an overlay on top of the screen — no window frame, and it never steals the keyboard focus. Grid and overlay switch live in the editor on the right when no key is selected.
decks.transparentHint: No panel underneath — only the tiles float above the screen.
decks.hideEmptyHint: Unassigned slots stay blank and ignore clicks; their space is kept so nothing jumps around.
decks.networkHint: This deck is operated from another machine on the same network, in a browser. You set the grid and tile size here — the guest cannot change anything.
decks.passwordSet: set — enter a new one to change it
decks.passwordHint: At least 4 characters. The password is only stored encrypted and never shown again. Changing it disconnects everyone currently connected.
decks.passwordClearConfirm: Without a password the deck is no longer offered on the network. Remove it?
decks.networkEnabledHint: Switched off, the deck stays an ordinary deck that only exists here. Once no network deck is active, the server stops listening entirely.
decks.networkAddressHint: Open this address in the browser on the other machine and enter the password. Reachable on the same network only — a network deck does not belong on the internet.
decks.networkOff: Not on the network right now — the switch above is off.
decks.networkNoPassword: Set a password first, then the deck is offered on the network.
decks.addNetworkHint: A network deck is operated by someone else on the same network in a browser — your mod during a stream, for instance. They only see this one deck and cannot change it. Password and address live in the editor on the right when no key is selected.
